items.prompt: An empty, white, featureless room that seems larger than it should be; in the very centre a young woman with red hair sits on a simple stool with her eyes closed and hands on her knees, seen from a distance, an old man standing quietly at the edge of the room.

alt.ru: Пустая белая комната, кажущаяся больше, чем есть; в центре на табурете с закрытыми глазами сидит рыжая девушка, у края комнаты тихо стоит старик.
alt.en: An empty white room that seems larger than it is; in the centre a red-haired young woman sits on a stool with eyes closed, an old man standing quietly at the edge.
alt.pt: Uma sala branca vazia que parece maior do que é; ao centro uma jovem ruiva sentada num banco de olhos fechados, um velho de pé, calado, à margem.
alt.es: Una sala blanca y vacía que parece más grande de lo que es; en el centro una joven pelirroja sentada en un taburete con los ojos cerrados, un anciano de pie en silencio en el borde.
